evals.name: buildkit-exception-prod-only
evals.prompt: falco 오탐 예외 추가: CI runner 노드에서 buildkit이 /etc 아래 쓰기 해서 'Write below etc' 알람이 뜸. runner는 prod 클러스터에만 있음
evals.expected_output: Uses override exceptions append, never append true; exception keys on container.id host with proc.aname buildkitd, not a buildkit/ container.id prefix; added only to the prod environment in its own customRules key so the common rules-custom.yaml survives the Helm merge; falco --validate loads the stable and sandbox rulesets together with the custom files.

evals.name: kubectl-exec-detection
evals.prompt: 프로덕션 파드에 kubectl exec로 쉘 들어가는 걸 탐지하는 falco 룰 작성해줘
evals.expected_output: Uses the k8s_audit source via k8saudit-eks on the existing falco DaemonSet (syscalls cannot see pods/exec); output carries namespace, pod, user, and command; scoped to application namespaces with a separate exception for debug namespaces; any Talon action matches the exact rule name; validation loads the k8saudit-eks and json plugins.

evals.name: override-load-error
evals.prompt: falco 파드 로그에 LOAD_ERR_VALIDATE: Rule uses 'append' or 'override.<key>: append' but no rule by that name already exists 에러가 'Write below etc' 예외 추가한 뒤로 계속 뜸. 원인 찾고 고쳐줘
evals.expected_output: Identifies that Write below etc lives in the sandbox ruleset, which is not loaded; fixes it by adding the falco-sandbox-rules falcoctl ref and the falco-sandbox_rules.yaml rules_files entry, not by turning the override into a full rule redefinition or append true; validates with falco_rules.yaml, falco-sandbox_rules.yaml, and the custom file together.
